confidence_notes: Meal, coffee and beer anchors rest on Numbeo-based Tokyo figures surfaced in search (mid-2026) and guide price ranges; beer assumes about a 500 ml draft. Cocktail uses guide ranges and a small sample. Wine glass is set at about twice the local draft beer price because direct wine evidence was stale or hotel-skewed. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for July 2026, not checked against live listings. Yen converted at about 159 JPY per USD from the 18 November 2026 RBA readings, not a July rate; no 19 November reading was confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Food and drink anchors come from Tokyo's own aggregated price figures, the wine glass from the local draft beer price, and accommodation from general knowledge of Tokyo hostel and hotel tiers.
